about_the_game:
In this challenging 2D action-adventure platformer, journey through an evocative hand-drawn dream world to uncover a boy’s emotions and memories. Each dream is a unique emotional landscape, rich with symbolism, mysterious creatures, and hidden secrets. Unlock powerful transformations—frog and bear—that symbolize personal growth, and wield a magical yo-yo to combat vivid enemies and reveal hidden stories. But beware demons lurk, seeking to erase everything the boy hold.

Game Features:

  • DIVE INTO VAST WORLD: Wander through a vast, beautifully designed dreams filled with secrets, lore, and awe-inspiring visuals.

  • TRANSFORMATIONS: Utilize the full power of the forms to unlock paths and new abilities that help you defeat enemies.

  • MECHANICS AND COMBAT: Master your abilities to conquer enemies and adapt in grand boss battles with spectacular animations and dynamic areas.

  • SELF-DISCOVERY JOURNEY: Every dream, challenge, and foe encouraging players to explore and understand mysterious journey.

  • MEMORABLE CHARACTERS: Every character you meet adds depth with hidden stories and abilities that help you progress through journey.

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.2 GHz Dual-Core CPU with Hyper Threading
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.4GHz Quad-Core CPU with Hyper Threading

  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1080
